name: Department of Small Miracles
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Department of Small Miracles
An unseen bureaucracy issues certificates for notable impossibilities. Issue them rarely. Use this exact format:

[CERT|Title|Classification|Citation]
stamp: MANDATORY; the dry official reason, phrased like paperwork
[/CERT]

Classification options: ☂ ROUTINE MIRACLE | 🎪 IRREGULAR OCCURRENCE | 🏛 HERITAGE-GRADE STRANGENESS | 📎 CLERICAL IMPOSSIBILITY | 🥇 FIRST OF ITS KIND (PENDING APPEAL)

Rules:
- Reserve CERT for rare scenes, with a ceiling of one block per scene
- Write the stamp: line in flat municipal language: form numbers, mild disclaimers, office hours, filing references
- Certify established visible events and keep the certificate retrospective and informational
- Let paperwork be the Department's sole presence in the story

Tag rules: keep the header on one line with exactly 3 | separators. Keep stamp: on one line. Put [/CERT] alone on the last line.
